requirements.title: Add task
requirements.text: The system shall let the user add a task by entering a text description which, after leading and trailing spaces are trimmed, is 1 to 200 characters long.
acceptanceCriteria: Entering text and confirming adds a new task to the list
The new task is shown as not done
An empty description is not added
A description consisting only of spaces is not added
Leading and trailing spaces are removed from the stored text
A description of 200 characters after trimming is accepted
A description of 201 characters after trimming is rejected

requirements.title: Mark task done or not done
requirements.text: The system shall let the user mark a task as done and mark a done task as not done again.
acceptanceCriteria: Ticking a task changes it to the done state
Unticking a done task changes it back to the not-done state
The done state is visibly distinguishable from the not-done state

requirements.title: Persist tasks on server
requirements.text: The system shall store tasks and their done state on a server so they are available when the user returns, including after the browser's local data is reset.
acceptanceCriteria: After adding tasks and ticking some, closing and reopening the app shows the same tasks with the same done states
After clearing the browser's local storage and cookies, reopening the app shows the same tasks

requirements.title: Run in browser
requirements.text: The system shall be usable in a web browser.
acceptanceCriteria: All features are usable in a web browser without installing additional software

requirements.title: Edit task
requirements.text: The system shall let the user edit the text of an existing task, applying the same trimming and length rules as when adding a task.
acceptanceCriteria: After editing and confirming, the task shows the new text and keeps its done state
The edited text is kept after reopening the app
An empty, whitespace-only, or over 200 character (after trimming) edit is rejected and the old text is kept
Leading and trailing spaces in the edited text are removed

requirements.title: Delete task
requirements.text: The system shall let the user delete a task.
acceptanceCriteria: After deleting, the task no longer appears in the list
The task is still gone after reopening the app

requirements.title: Done tasks display and order
requirements.text: The system shall keep done tasks in the list, show their text struck through, list open tasks before done tasks, and order tasks within each group oldest first by creation time.
acceptanceCriteria: A done task remains visible in the list with struck-through text
Every open task appears above every done task
Within the open tasks, the earliest created task is first
Within the done tasks, the earliest created task is first
Unticking a done task shows it without strike-through among the open tasks, at its creation-time position

requirements.title: Single user without login
requirements.text: The system shall serve a single user and shall not require login.
acceptanceCriteria: The app opens directly to the task list without any login step

outOfScope: User accounts, login and multi-user support
Browser-only storage as the sole persistence
